title: Family Story Interview
shareTitle: Family Story Interview — Make a Memory Together
description: Pick a picture question, interview a loved grown-up, record their answer, decorate a private keepsake page, and replay it from an on-device family memory book.
learningGoals: Ask a clear open-ended question and listen through an answer
Notice and retell a meaningful detail from a family story
Build intergenerational connection through oral history
interactionModel: Choose one of three picture-led question families, hear a prompt, record a grown-up or continue without microphone access, add an optional local photo and watercolor sticker, save, replay, and browse up to twelve on-device memory pages.
feedbackModel: Warm recorded narration, paper-lift motion, a live waveform, tactile record and save sounds, sticker placement, a page stamp, and gentle celebration accept every family answer without scoring.

modes.title: When You Were Little
modes.skill: ask and listen to a childhood detail

modes.title: Favorite Things
modes.skill: invite descriptive language about a meaningful favorite

modes.title: Family Traditions
modes.skill: listen for the people and order in a family ritual

privacy.recording: optional microphone audio plus optional imported or captured photo
privacy.storage: IndexedDB on the current device only, with session-memory fallback

assets.runtimeNetworkScope: No game asset, model, transcription, child-recording, or family-photo requests; inherited platform analytics is outside this flag.
assets.art: GPT Image 2 Watercolor / Storybook masters, deterministic cutter-mask mattes, and a Krea 2 hub tile
assets.voice: Qwen voice-cloned teacher narration with Whisper QA and Web Speech fallback
